input.summary: Signed in to the CoreServ back-office console, ran a Member Lookup for member number ***0001, and read the Member Summary screen. Extracted the member's name (Alice Harborview), savings balance ($2,540.12 — Primary Savings / S01), and checking balance ($1,203.55 — Everyday Checking / S05). Read-only; no changes were made.
input.name: Read member name and share balances
input.description: Logs into the CoreServ 7.2.14 back-office console, looks up a member by full member number on the Member Lookup screen, and reads the Member Summary page to return the member's name plus the current balances of their savings and checking shares. Outputs: memberName (string, member's full name as shown in the "Name" label; PII), savingsBalance (currency, Balance column of the Savings share row), checkingBalance (currency, Balance column of the Checking share row). Strictly read-only — it navigates and reads, never submits a change.
input.whenToUse: Use when an agent or [secret] needs a quick, authoritative read of a member's identity and deposit balances from the core system — e.g. verifying funds before a transfer, answering a member balance inquiry, or enriching a case file. Requires the exact full member number; the lookup does not do partial or name-based search.
input.notFor: Not for moving money, opening sub-accounts, card services, or any other state-changing operation. Not for loan details (the summary also lists loans but this capability does not return them). Not for partial-match or name/SSN searches, and not for members whose number is unknown.

params.name: memberNumber
params.description: The member's full member number to look up, e.g. "***0001". Partial numbers are not supported.
